transaction.reason: The existing check's partial criterion treats any white disc as progress, although the edited image appears to remove the labeled DVD and show separate white discs, with the black object still present. This is a perception/target-binding and fulfillment-criteria problem, not a missing instruction requirement. Split the outcome to distinguish transformation of the original DVD with identity retained from merely introducing a white disc; the latter is not requested progress.
